# vendor/

Curated lookup tables that the pipeline joins in but does not compute at build
time.

## `collections/<name>/`

Vendored collection extracts (see `notes/collections-spec.md`), one directory
per protocol-varied collection. Generated by the matching extractor under
`scripts/collections/` (run manually — sample files are multi-GB and CI never
touches them). Each directory holds:

| file | contents |
| --- | --- |
| `manifest.json` | pinned EEE revision, member record enumeration (uuid / evaluation_id / path / per-record result count), expected fragment-drop count, extraction stats |
| `results.parquet` | reassembled synthetic results at `results_exploded` grain + `protocol_condition` / `n_trajectories` |
| `trajectories.parquet` | one row per stitched trajectory (spec §5.5) |

At canonicalise time the adapter (`sources/collections.py`) drops the member
records' exploded fragment rows and injects the synthetic results pre-Stage C.
Unlike the verified-evaluator join below (which degrades silently to FALSE),
this adapter **hard-fails** when its inputs are inconsistent — an EEE pin bump
that includes collection data changes must carry the extractor re-run and the
regenerated `vendor/collections/**` in the same PR.

## `is_verified_evaluator.parquet` / `evaluator_affiliation.parquet`

Generated by `scripts/verified_evaluator/`: `eee_org_mapping.py` recovers
each record's original submitter from EEE_datastore PR/git history, then
`apply_affiliation.py` applies the curated (submitter, source_org) decisions it
holds and rewrites both parquets here. To refresh after new datastore
submissions, run the two scripts in that order; an unreviewed new pair fails
the completeness check until a decision is added.

### `is_verified_evaluator.parquet`

Per evaluation record: whether the evaluation was **submitted by the organisation
that ran it** (vs. re-hosted from someone else's leaderboard). Stage D LEFT-joins
this on `evaluation_id` and emits the boolean `is_verified_evaluator` on
`fact_results`; records absent from the lookup default to `false`.

| column | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `evaluation_id` | string | join key (matches `fact_results.evaluation_id`) |
| `record_uuid` | string | source record id; cross-check |
| `source_organization_name` | string | the org that ran the eval |
| `submitter_author` | string | who submitted it upstream ("" if direct-pushed) |
| `is_verified_evaluator` | bool | true = submitter belongs to the source org |
| `reason` | string | one-line justification for the call |

### `evaluator_affiliation.parquet`

The distinct `(submitter_author, source_organization_name)` decisions behind
the per-record table, each with a record count and a one-line `reason`. Read this
to audit *why* a record is (un)validated.
